why: Build for ticket 1073 slice 1 in next/ and our tooling: the nine renamed next/ test files had stale rows in vitest.shards.json and vitest.shards.full.json (17 rows, shard-rows.ts failing, six laws in vitest.shards.test.ts red). A throwaway script read the renames from git diff -M and renamed each row key in place, keeping its seconds. The stale file name in vitest.shards.ts's comment moved to RepositoriesGit.integration.test.ts. The deps and laws-scan splits are out of this slice by the lead's call.
note: L18 and F2 stayed red after the row move because a stale vitest results cache in node_modules/.vite held node-kinds.test.ts as failed, and the sequencer starts a failed file first. Deleting that local cache folder made vitest.shards.test.ts pass 34 of 34. This is local state, not in git.
